bounded_statement: The selected result's per-unit agreement rate of 0.208333 (5/24) and accumulated emission of 5.000 credits were computed by comparing pcr_call against the complemented panel (1 - panel_allele), not against the panel_allele values in the coding in which they were supplied; against the supplied coding the agreement is 19 of 24 units (0.791667), a figure the report itself states in its accounting section while its selected result and rate line carry the complemented-panel numbers, contradicting both the task instruction and the report's own claim that the supplied coding was used.

counterevidence_considered.description: The report does state the correct supplied-coding agreement count (19), which could suggest the supplied panel was used; however, tracing the code shows this number is staged_agreement_units = total_units - emission_total, a back-computed complement of the complemented-panel tally, and it does not feed the reported agreement rate, the emission credits, or the selected result, all of which carry the complement-derived 5/24 and 5.000.
counterevidence_considered.observed_value: staged_agreement_units = 24 - 5 = 19 is derived from, not independent of, the complemented-panel emission, and is excluded from the selected result

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to defeat the verdict two ways. First, I considered whether PANEL_CODE_TOP - staged_value could be a legitimate coding normalization (e.g., if the panel were supplied in inverted coding); the report itself states panel_allele is supplied as 0/1 with the same semantics as pcr_call, the task mandates using the supplied coding, and no protocol deviation is claimed ('No protocol amendment or approved method deviation exists'), so the subtraction is a complementation, not a normalization. Second, I checked whether the selected result might nonetheless reflect the supplied-coding comparison: hand-recounting the 24 rows gives 19/24 agreement as supplied and 5/24 against the complement; the reported rate 0.208333 (5/24) and emission 5.000 match the complement exactly and cannot arise from the supplied coding. Both falsification attempts failed, so the demonstrated-issue verdict stands.

root_cause: workflow/analysis.py defines panel_state to return PANEL_CODE_TOP - int(entry[PANEL_COLUMN]) (i.e., 1 minus the staged panel_allele), so every concordance_credit call in the emission loop compares the observed call to the complemented panel value; emission_total therefore counts complement-matches (5), and agreement_rate = emission_total / total_units yields 5/24 instead of the supplied-coding 19/24, while the derived quantity staged_agreement_units = total_units - emission_total back-computes the supplied-coding count for one narrative line, masking the inversion.
